purpose: Represent only externally observable transport operations for one bounded productive-unit scope, with an explicit coverage boundary that decides whether a counter is numeric or UNKNOWN.

fields.external_target_family: bounded external family such as github_contents, github_actions, public_http, connector
fields.durable_evidence_or_null: exact durable/server evidence ref when one exists, else null; null never means operation absent
fields.retry_of_class_or_null: READ | WRITE | WAIT for RETRY so the repeated external attempt is counted in both retries and the underlying external-op counter
fields.note_or_null: compact diagnostic only; never a counter authority

coverage_contract.complete_rule: COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE requires non-empty coverage_evidence_refs that close the declared bounded transport scope for that counter.
coverage_contract.partial_rule: PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE always summarize as UNKNOWN, even when one or more observed operations provide a lower bound.
coverage_contract.zero_rule: Numeric zero is emitted only for COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE plus non-empty coverage_evidence_refs. No events + partial coverage is UNKNOWN, never 0.
coverage_contract.positive_rule: Numeric positives require at least one in-trace operation evidence ref or durable operation ref, plus complete coverage.
coverage_contract.unknown_rule: PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE requires unknown_reason and may expose observed_minimum as a diagnostic lower bound.

derivation.external_read_ops: Count READ plus RETRY where retry_of_class=READ.
derivation.external_write_ops: Count WRITE plus RETRY where retry_of_class=WRITE; failed/conflicting mutation attempts count when observed.
derivation.workflow_waits: Count WAIT plus RETRY where retry_of_class=WAIT.
derivation.commits: Not derived by this trace candidate; keep the existing accounting contract and durable commit evidence.
derivation.artifacts: Not derived by this trace candidate; keep the existing accounting contract and artifact listing evidence.

coalescing.durable_persist_target: one bounded trace/evidence object or existing productive-unit RETURN/exam attachment
coalescing.rule: Transport may observe many external operations in memory/runtime, but durable worker coordination stays coalesced. Local reasoning is never emitted as an operation.

real_sample_policy.rule: A real sample may demonstrate durable observed operations while counters remain UNKNOWN if the connector/runtime cannot prove the observation boundary is closed.
